$Comment: The stacked bar panel in the left column: the running ledger of whatever a player is in the
middle of. A row appears the moment a mod reports a value moved and goes away when it stops;
nothing is authored for one to show up. Server/ZiggfreedCommon/HudBars/ is where you retune a
single row, and this file is the panel they all sit on.
Position is a corner preset (TopLeft, TopCenter, TopRight, CenterLeft, Center, CenterRight,
BottomLeft, BottomCenter, BottomRight) plus pixel offsets from the edges that preset pins. The
default sits high in the left column, deliberately over the mob inspector card another mod draws
there: the panel is transparent behind its frame and the two read fine stacked. Move it to clear
whatever else your server puts in that corner.
Columns and RowsPerColumn decide how the rows spread out as more of them move at once. Left as
they are, the panel stays one narrow column until nine rows are going, then opens a second one
rather than running off the bottom of the screen. Raise RowsPerColumn for a taller single column,
or set Columns to 1 to keep it one column however busy things get. MaxVisible is unstated, so
every slot the panel has is available; state a smaller number to keep it short, and the most
recently moved rows are the ones you see.
RepaintMs is how often the panel redraws at most. A movement redraws immediately when the last
redraw is already that old, and one arriving sooner is drawn at the window's end, so a number on
screen is never left waiting on a later movement to bring it up to date. Lower is livelier and
costs more network traffic.
To change a leaf without copying this file, add an entry keyed 'Default' to
mods/ziggfreedcommon/hud-bar-panels.json with only the leaves you want different. Set Enabled to
false there to switch this whole panel off.
